scope: Read-only production PIXELS menu-observer feasibility from existing H2 captures and frozen shipped interfaces; no new model, GUI, input or source changes.

positive_visible_text_examples: Save Ctrl $ Save As_ Shift Ctrl $ Save Copy_ Save Incremental Ctrl Alt $

evidence_limit: Three known states from one factory desktop are examples, not calibrated error/coverage bounds. All 412 parsed objects have confidence=null; no supplied popup/member/coverage relation exists.

current_interfaces.UIObject: bbox,label,role,confidence,actions,source,sensitive plus nullable visible/enabled/editable/focused/occluded; no popup identity, parent or coverage
current_interfaces.SessionRuntime._operation_state: captures frame but builds Observation(objects=()); only an injected local state_provider can supply menus
current_interfaces.StateCompiler.compile: binds StateFact source/timestamp/version/validity/uncertainty; absent evidence remains UNKNOWN
current_interfaces.CompiledState.require: rejects non-VALID or uncertainty>0.1; do not invent a lower uncertainty to authorize a visual inference
current_interfaces.OperationRunner._menu: consumes the menus fact only; [] means ABSENT, so a failed detector must never return [] as a successful fact

conclusion: Existing objects and pixels provide useful positive witnesses, but cannot presently justify trustworthy production OPEN/WRONG_MENU at the unchanged state gate. A new verified pixel observer would need explicit popup geometry/member association and uncertainty/coverage handling; it is not implemented or advertised.

OPEN: Observed requested header identity from OCR, not caption guesses
Independently supported popup outline and header linkage derived from current image, not fixed coordinates
Coherent spatially associated visible menu-member evidence and unambiguous root-popup identity
No unaccounted multiple, clipped, overlapping or occluded popup candidate
Validated evidence uncertainty compatible with existing require gate; otherwise UNKNOWN
WRONG_MENU: Complete relevant visible-popup coverage sufficient to exclude the requested menu; identifying one different popup alone is insufficient
positive_rule_requirements.ABSENT: No evidence of items is not proof of no menu. Without explicit trustworthy visible coverage, return UNKNOWN rather than VALID [].

counterexamples.observed_evidence: File label exists in all three H2 states, including EDIT_WRONG and ABSENT.

counterexamples.risk: A text editor, help document or panel can contain Open Recent/Save/Preferences without an open menu; require actual popup geometry and header linkage.

counterexamples.observed_evidence: One File object joins Save, Save As, Save Copy and Save Incremental; one box must not be treated as four independently verified menu members.

counterexamples.risk: One positive popup cannot certify uniqueness or WRONG_MENU if another root/submenu is unresolved; current flat menus contract has no hierarchy, so refuse ambiguous cases.
Missing OCR members cannot certify absence or coverage.
English item vocabulary and dark-theme outlines from one capture do not validate other locales, themes or geometry; unsupported identity stays UNKNOWN.

counterexamples.observed_evidence: box_yolo_content_yolo objects include generic profile/blurry captions; they are not direct observed menu text.

counterexamples.risk: OmniParser may exceed the 1-second state-fact lifetime. Use actual capture time and refuse stale pixels; never timestamp old pixels as fresh at parse completion.

minimum_trustworthy_data_needed: Direct OCR recognition evidence retained with source and measured reliability; detection text_threshold is not semantic confidence
A real popup-boundary and header/member spatial relation extracted from pixels, with clipping/overlap/coverage flags
Frame/window binding and true capture timestamp; a later equal-image/window recapture may establish freshness only when actually observed
Version/locale identity only if independently observed, or UNKNOWN for unsupported translation
Representative positive/negative real captures and held-out counterexamples to establish the acceptance boundary without reducing thresholds

at_most_one_implementation_slice.name: Read-only pixel menu witness extraction and validation
at_most_one_implementation_slice.description: One bounded observer consuming the unflattened current UIObjects and original frame pixels. Derive popup candidates and text membership without mutating objects/actions; retain raw supporting object IDs and dynamic geometry. Emit UNKNOWN on missing identity/coverage/confidence. Only connect a production menus StateFact after its real negative/ambiguity validation establishes the unchanged gate; do not add a provider stub, guess numeric facts, or promote default readiness.

privacy: No raw screenshots, model transcript, scene payloads, credentials or cache paths included.
